# Draft:The 2025 Culture Awards

The 2025 Culture Awards was the 4th installment of the Las Culturistas Culture Awards, an annual live parody award show hosted by Matt Rogers and Boyen Yang, creators of the Las Culturistas podcast. The 2025 edition was the first one to be televised, airing on Bravo on August 5th 2025 . The broadwast was available to stream on Peacock the following day.
